name: ephpm/db
description: Base PHP library for ePHPm's in-process database bridge — a typed wrapper, exception hierarchy, and IDE stubs for the native ephpm_db_query()/ephpm_db_execute() functions.

ephpm.comment: stubs/ephpm-db.stub.php is an IDE/static-analysis stub ONLY. It is intentionally NOT listed in autoload.files: at runtime the global ephpm_db_query()/ephpm_db_execute() functions are provided natively by the ePHPm engine, and autoloading the stub would redefine them and fatal. Point your analyzer (PhpStorm, Psalm, PHPStan) at the stubs/ directory instead.
